title: questtimerframe
summary: MSUI now implements current Benilla's separate timed-quest window: live server-clock subtraction with the byte-verified minus-one bias, failed/untimed/expired filtering, log-order rows, exact SecondsToTime spelling, 160px dialog and header art, 45 + 16*n height, twenty exact row seats, hover quest title, click-to-open/select, and the managed quest-timer to durability to quest-watch stack. Deterministic geometry and production-wiring checks pass; a live timed quest and pixel comparison remain open.

openItems.text: Verify a live timed quest counts down, opens the correct quest-log entry on click, disappears on expiry/failure, and moves the durability and quest-watch frames by its dynamic height at multiple UI scales.
